usageNote: 地点介词on在这里超灵活！表示'处于某阶段'，expedition就是那种听起来超酷的探险之旅～

examples.en: She was on the last stop of her expedition when she finally spotted the rare bird.
examples.zh: 她在探险的最后一站，终于发现了那只稀有的鸟。

examples.en: On the last stop of her expedition, she took photos of the ancient ruins.
examples.zh: 在探险的最后一站，她拍下了古老遗迹的照片。
